summary: Native Stripe recurring subscriptions verified end-to-end against REAL Stripe test API. Backend endpoints, DB persistence, activation idempotency, and Cancel/Reactivate all confirmed working against api.stripe.com. Found and FIXED one critical bug: emergent StripeCheckout global api_base poisoning. Found one open UI bug in Pricing.jsx (credits count missing on plan cards).

minor.issue: When called with an unknown session_id, returns 404 only if user has no txn for that id; if session_id has no txn but stripe_sdk.checkout.Session.retrieve is called on it (i.e. txn exists), returns 502. Acceptable behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Subscription plan cards render '{p.credits} credits' but /api/plans returns each plan with key 'monthly_credits' (not 'credits'). Result: on /pricing the Monthly/3-Month/Annual cards show '$20', blank, 'credits' with the number missing (see screenshot in this iteration). Users cannot see how many credits each plan grants. Fix: use p.monthly_credits instead of p.credits (lines 66 and 68 of Pricing.jsx).

action_items: Fix Pricing.jsx lines 66 and 68: change {p.credits} -> {p.monthly_credits} so subscription cards display the credit count.

(OPTIONAL) The emergent StripeCheckout SDK mutates the GLOBAL stripe.api_base to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe when STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent'. I patched server.py to defensively reset stripe_sdk.api_base to https://api.stripe.com before every native Stripe SDK call (added _use_native_stripe() helper, called from _get_or_create_customer, subscription_checkout, subscription_checkout_status, cancel/reactivate, and stripe_native_webhook). This is required for native subscriptions to work; without it, the FIRST subscription checkout may work but any subsequent call after ANY /api/checkout/session (credit pack) call fails with 'No such price/customer' because the global proxy base does not have the user's own recurring price IDs.
Register the Stripe webhook /api/webhook/stripe-native with a signing secret so renewals can be tested (out of scope for this iteration per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: Global mutation bug (patched): emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout.__init__ sets stripe.api_base to the emergent proxy when key is sk_test_emergent. Any code that mixes emergent StripeCheckout and native stripe_sdk in the same process is fragile. The added _use_native_stripe() helper is defensive but the right long-term fix is to isolate stripe_sdk client state (e.g., use stripe.StripeClient(api_key=..., base_url='https://api.stripe.com') instead of the module-level singleton).

_get_or_create_customer: if the stored stripe_customer_id becomes invalid in Stripe (e.g., manual dashboard deletion), the endpoint returns 502 indefinitely. Consider catching stripe.error.InvalidRequestError with 'No such customer' and recreating.

subscription_checkout_status: only handles status=='complete' path. If Stripe returns 'expired'/'open' the txn stays processed:false forever (fine, but polling stops after 8 attempts on the frontend).

process_subscription: for stripe_native subs, skips simulated renewal (correct), but the 30-day credit reset loop still runs — this may reset plan_credits before Stripe actually charges the customer if the local ncr diverges from Stripe's billing cycle. Consider syncing next_credit_reset from Stripe subscription.current_period_start on renewal webhook.

cancel_at_period_end path in _activate_native_sub uses whatever Stripe returns — good. But if user re-subscribes, plan_credits is force-set to plan['monthly_credits'] wiping any accumulated plan_credits from a prior active plan. That's fine for upgrade/downgrade but should be documented.
Pricing.jsx uses {p.credits} for subscription plans; backend returns 'monthly_credits' — silent UI bug (see frontend_issues).

subscription_checkout writes payment_transactions BEFORE the Stripe session is confirmed; if the user abandons checkout the txn stays processed:false with status:open forever. Consider cleanup or expiring old rows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Native Stripe subscription flow works end-to-end. The key gotcha: emergent StripeCheckout mutates stripe.api_base globally to the emergent proxy when sk_test_emergent key is used. The patch in server.py (_use_native_stripe helper) resets it before every native call. If E1 refactors the payments code, keep this in mind. To test UI checkout completion end-to-end, note that Stripe's hosted checkout now presents a payment-method accordion; the Card option must be clicked via its accordion button before card fields are visible (selectors like input[value='card'] or '#accordion-item-card' vary). Alternative: use stripe_sdk.Subscription.create + tok_visa payment method directly (see /tmp/e2e_stripe_backend_flow.py).
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (FIXED by testing agent): Global stripe.api_base pollution. Reproduction: (a) log in as admin; (b) call POST /api/checkout/session for any credit pack (this instantiates emergent StripeCheckout which sets stripe.api_base='https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe' at module level); (c) call POST /api/subscription/checkout — fails 502 'No such price' because the emergent proxy backend does not have the user's recurring price IDs. Mitigation: _use_native_stripe() helper resets api_base to https://api.stripe.com before every native SDK call in server.py. Bug 2 (OPEN — needs E1 fix): Pricing.jsx renders p.credits which is undefined for subscriptions (backend returns monthly_credits).
